summary: SmartKem, Inc. filed an 8-K to report extending a $2.3M convertible bridge loan to Ferrox Critical Minerals. The loan carries 5% annual interest, matures October 30, 2026, and is convertible into Ferrox ordinary shares at the lower of fair market value or a valuation based on $80M total equity. SmartKem received a $200K origination fee; default triggers a $4,500/day fee and 15% interest. The note includes negative covenants and a right of first refusal on fundamental transactions. This is a financing agreement, not a special situation.
